rows.note: Use 隊長 as the all-purpose term for the leader or captain of an organized team, unit, or work group.

example.english: Ming is captain for this match, and he will speak to the referee at crucial moments.
example.traditional: 今場比賽由阿明做隊長，關鍵時刻佢會同裁判交涉。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 jau4 aa3 ming4 zou6 deoi6 zoeng2 gwaan1 gin6 si4 hak1 keoi5 wui5 tung4 coi4 pun3 gaau1 sip3

rows.note: Use 船長 specifically for the person in command of a ship or other vessel.

example.english: The captain said the waves ahead were rough and told us all to stay in the cabin.
example.traditional: 船長話前面風浪大，叫我哋全部留喺船艙。
example.jyutping: syun4 zoeng2 waa6 cin4 min6 fung1 long6 daai6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 lau4 hai2 syun4 cong1

rows.note: Use 機長 specifically for the pilot in command of an airline flight.

example.english: The captain announced that the flight would be delayed by half an hour.
example.traditional: 機長宣布航班會遲到半個鐘。
example.jyutping: gei1 zoeng2 syun1 bou3 hong4 baan1 wui5 ci4 dou3 bun3 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use 上尉 for the military rank of captain in the army.

example.english: The captain explained this mission to the new recruits.
example.traditional: 上尉向新兵講解今次任務。
example.jyutping: soeng6 wai3 hoeng3 san1 bing1 gong2 gaai2 gam1 ci3 jam6 mou6
